description: A pair of eyeglasses lies on the table beside a small white folding glasses case, with a dark pillow in the background. The left hand reaches in from the left toward the glasses while the right hand comes in from the right; the right hand lifts and steadies the glasses as the left hand helps fold the arms, then the left hand pulls the case closer and opens it so the right hand can place the glasses inside, after which both hands close and secure the case and let it rest on the table.
